1) Scope & classification
- Covered workloads: user-facing chat + healthcare triage assistant (PHI in scope).
- Regulatory posture you flagged: HIPAA for US patients, GDPR for EU subjects.

2) Evidence & docs requested by Dovetail (you):
- SOC 2 Type II summary + control map (we can share our attestation + mapping).
- Incident response timelines and breach-notification commitments (you asked for detection → notification SLA).
- BCP/DR highlights (RTO/RPO targets, DR test cadence, contact tree).
- Vendor security questionnaire (you said procurement would send spreadsheet).

3) Immediate actions we agreed:
- Redwood to share our SOC 2 summary + a redacted BCP/DR snippet by EOD tomorrow. (Action: Redwood)
- Dovetail to send the vendor questionnaire to procurements@redwood.example.com and copy security@redwood.example.com. (Action: Dovetail)
- Schedule a 45–60 minute technical review with Marcus (SE) for next week to walk controls around PHI handling. (Action: joint scheduling)

Please confirm if I missed anything. If those deadlines look tight, call it out and we’ll adjust. I’ve attached a proposed evidence bundle list and a template for the questionnaire intake to speed the transfer.

Thanks,

Thanks Aisha — that summary looks right. We attached our vendor questionnaire (see attached) and a short list of follow-ups that matter to legal & security: 

Key clarifications we need up front:
- SOC 2: do you have a Type II report for 2025? If not, please provide control narratives + compensating controls.
- Data residency: which regions can we pin for PHI processing? (we prefer US-east or customer VPC).
- IR: what is your committed breach-notification timeline after confirmed compromise? Do you provide a customer-facing playbook?
- BCP/DR: we need RTO/RPO targets for the inference service and a sample DR test report.

Procurement will triage the questionnaire and route any contract redlines separately. For now, can your security team share the SOC 2 summary and any redacted DR evidence by end-of-day Friday so our security review can begin?

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.example.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@dovetailhealth.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dovetail Health — compliance kickoff / questionnaire

Elena — looping in Neha (security/compliance) and dropping the artifacts we discussed. Quick notes from Security/SE perspective: 

1) SOC 2: We do have a SOC 2 Type II for the period covering 2024-01 to 2024-12. Due to audit confidentiality we can share: 
- RI_SOC2_summary_2025.pdf (control summary + mapping to common criteria).
- A redaction-friendly control map that maps to vendor questionnaire items (exported sections highlighted).

2) Incident response / breach notification
- Internal detection → initial triage: typically within 4–24 hours depending on alert maturity.
- Confirmed compromise → customer notification window: committed 72 hours from confirmation of unauthorized access affecting customer data (we provide interim updates as investigation progresses).
- We maintain a customer-facing IR playbook (redacted) and can run a joint tabletop if helpful.

3) BCP/DR
- RTO: 1–4 hours for stateless inference nodes, 12–24 hours for control-plane failover (varies by deployment mode: hosted vs dedicated vs private).
- RPO: best-effort for in-flight session state; persistent data (logs/metrics) RPO is up to 1 hour in hosted mode; customers on Dedicated/Private can configure stricter SLAs.
- Attached: BCP_DR_Snippets.docx (redacted excerpts showing test cadence & last drill date).

4) Data residency
- Hosted: US-east and EU-west regions; PHI processing in hosted mode is supported when customers contract for HIPAA addendum and use a customer-managed key. Private/VPC deployments keep all processing in-customer VPC/region by design.

Next steps we propose:
- Aisha to schedule a technical walkthrough (Marcus + Neha) next Tue/Wed — 45 minutes.
- We’ll upload the two artifacts (SOC2 summary + BCP snippets) to the shared drive link and mark sensitive sections.

If Dovetail needs explicit RTO/RPO numbers for procurement, we can provide a short appendix with ranges per deployment type.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.example.com

Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Dovetail Health — compliance kickoff / IR timelines and BCP details

Marcus / Neha — appreciate the documents. Quick follow-ups (procurement needs more precise language for the SOW/BAA):

1) The 72-hour notification is acceptable as an operational target, but legal needs the wording we’ll include in the BAA: is the commitment "72 hours after confirmation of unauthorized access impacting customer data" or "72 hours after discovery"? Those are materially different for us.

2) For RTO/RPO we need concrete ranges per deployment mode (hosted: exact figures; dedicated: expected SLA; private: depends on customer infra but give your tested numbers). Can you provide a one-page appendix with tested metrics from the last DR exercise (dates + outcomes)?

3) We also need evidence of at least one IR tabletop or post-incident review from the last 12 months (redacted OK) — a short timeline and lessons-learned summary. This will satisfy our audit team.

If you can share these items by EOD Monday our internal legal/procurement review can proceed and we’ll aim to get the questionnaire back to you by mid-next-week.

Regards,
Rajiv Suresh
Head of Security, Dovetail Health
rajiv@dovetailhealth.com
